lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately three horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The central row displays the highest pixel intensity and greatest spatial separation between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a non-continuous grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light dorsal-facing surface to a shadowed lateral-facing surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal and trailing edges of the visible pectoral fin exhibit irregular, jagged contours and pale pixel clusters, indicating potential physical trauma or scarring. Vertical linear striations are also visible in the branchial region.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated dark silhouettes (symbiotic fish) are visible in close proximity to the pectoral fin and ventral surface.
